Technology on Instagram: "Swipe ⬅️ to see how Artemis II mission combines massive cost, advanced engineering, and precise physics to send humans around the Moon for the first time in decades 🌕

Each launch costs $4.1 billion with $93 billion spent overall, while the SLS produces 8.8 million pounds of thrust, burns 733,000 gallons of fuel in 8 minutes, uses refurbished Space Shuttle engines, and Orion relies on 7 miles of cables, 1,200 sensors, Airbus built life support, laser systems streaming near real time 4K video, and a 10 day deep space journey.

Using a free return trajectory, the spacecraft swings around the Moon and returns using gravity after a 740,000 km trip, proving safety systems, testing human survival beyond Earth, and preparing for Artemis III where humans are planned to land again on the lunar surface.

Sources: NASA OIG · CBS News · NASA Artemis · Fox Weather · NASA · Astronomy Magazine · Wikipedia · Flying Magazine · Airbus · ESA · Gizmodo

#space #nasa #moon #technology #science"
